description: Profile a saved audience composition, including its segment set logic and exclusions. Returns a BigQuery-computed demographic breakdown, including median age, gender split, homeowner %, children %, college-educated %, and high-income %. Results may populate a 20-minute server-side cache and record query telemetry; the audience definition is unchanged. Requires 'discovery' scope.
